build: cargo build --workspace --bins --examples --release --locked; thin LTO, codegen-units1; no target-cpu native override
boundaries: Process cumulative CPU-time delta after3s warmup, >=20s measured, serial cases without concurrent build/test/benchmark. 100%=one logical core. RSS includes mapped/shared/graphics pages. Python sampler, WindowServer, GPU/driver watts excluded. Last-row quality sampled only. Before/after UI states can affect resource use.

h264_long.construction: Developer-only FFmpeg stream copy,24 sample repetitions; app never invokes FFmpeg. Artificial boundary jumps; resilient=n.

raw.pixels: exact legacy RGB-to-gray8bit bytes through next_tracking_frame(None) and write_y4m_frame
raw.scope: development-only grayscale resource fixture; source timing replaced by120FPS; not RGB capture or physical accuracy evidence

tracking_profile.boundary: Tracker::process only, including ROI, fitting, integration, map and numerical debug views; predecoded/preconverted immutable frames; no I/O, capture, pacing, UI or recording; initialization excluded

idle_diagnostics.sampling: Separate diagnostic only: tracking thread parked3815/3815 samples; decoder and control threads blocked; main thread mach_msg wait3755/3815. Remaining sampled work included egui/wgpu Metal drawable acquisition. High18.8% paused run did not reproduce; cause unresolved. Profiler overhead invalidates sampled case as a controlled benchmark.
